Thought: I need to determine when a drug reaches steady state based on its half-life. In pharmacokinetics, steady state is generally reached after approximately 4-5 half-lives of a drug. This is because after each half-life, the drug concentration approaches steady state by filling about half of the remaining gap.

- The half-life of digitoxin is 7 days
- After 1 half-life (7 days): 50% of steady state is reached
- After 2 half-lives (14 days): 75% of steady state is reached
- After 3 half-lives (21 days): 87.5% of steady state is reached
- After 4 half-lives (28 days): 93.75% of steady state is reached
- After 5 half-lives (35 days): 96.875% of steady state is reached

In clinical practice, we typically consider steady state to be reached after 4-5 half-lives, when the drug concentration is >90-95% of the final steady state value.
